origin: Retained full01 A/B evidence copied to the canonical R01 report directory.

method.stage_assignment: Assign each raw frame by its observed source_tick to the unique inclusive [first_tick,last_tick] interval in benchmark_camera.source_stage_ticks. Do not infer a stage from elapsed-time fractions or a nearest camera position.
method.window_assignment: floor(t_end_s/window_s), with the terminal boundary frame clamped to the last nominal window. Counts and p95 are checked against each retained performance-report window.
method.quantile: Linear interpolation at (count-1)*q in sorted observations (q=0.50,0.95,0.99). Means use statistics.fmean. No rounding is applied to saved computed values.
method.rss_alignment: PS invocation-start since_process_spawn_s minus monotonic receipt of R01_MEASURE_START. Keep numeric RSS for the raw PID only at offsets [0,duration_actual_s], excluding startup/warmup. Window intervals are left-closed, right-open; edge summaries use the first/last 30 measured seconds.
method.rss_coverage_note: Temporal span fraction is the span between first and last valid sample divided by measured duration; it is not frame-synchronous coverage or a count/seconds sampling percentage.
method.sha_binding: Inputs include compressed raw/report/batch/camera SHA-256. Frame batches also include the decompressed JSONL SHA-256 checked against raw.frame_storage.batch_file_sha256; compressed batch SHA is checked against report.frame_batches_sha256.
method.reproduction: Run reproduction_code with Python 3 from the repository root. It only reads evidence and prints the computed section; no engine, producer, generator or third-party dependency is invoked.

scope.observed_configuration: Apple M1 Pro, 16 GB, native Godot 4.7.2 debug build outside editor, Metal forward_plus, 1920x1080, 3D scale 1.0, uncapped and VSync disabled. A=0 NPC/0 vehicle for two 300-second loops; B=2 NPC/2 vehicle for four 300-second loops.
scope.camera: Time-compressed discrete replay of observed N04 poses from eleven source stages. Player remains stationary; this does not revalidate physical walking, human handling or traffic safety.
scope.causal_attribution: CPU versus GPU work, operating-system pacing, temperature effects and background-process effects are not separated. A/B observations are not randomized repeated trials; lower B frame times do not establish an actor-related performance improvement.
scope.memory: PS RSS is periodic resident process memory, not total allocation or GPU memory. Retained 1Hz actor/camera observations are part of the benchmark; MEMORY_STATIC rises while RSS does not grow monotonically. These data do not prove absence of a memory leak.
scope.system: Power, memory_pressure -Q, swap and background processes are before/after snapshots, not continuous pressure or thermal measurements. Swap already existed before both runs; no application-specific swap cause is established.
scope.claim_boundary: Supports adopting p95 frame time <=33.3 ms for this current M1 Pro/native/current-load configuration and deferring speculative optimization. No exported-package, M4, larger actor load, long-session guarantee or formal target-adoption mutation is implied.

preservation.basis: This analysis reads existing R01 files and creates only this new JSON. Raw/report/batch/camera hashes are checked before and after analysis; original R01 source/runtime/proof and N04 camera acceptance preservation checks are retained in computed.profiles. No current N04 source inventory is rehashed or N04 engine validation rerun.

reproduction_code:
import gzip,hashlib,json,math,statistics
from pathlib import Path

def sha256(path,gzip_payload=False):
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    with (gzip.open(path,'rb') if gzip_payload else path.open('rb')) as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()

def distribution(values):
    ordered=sorted(values)
    if not ordered:return {'count':0}
    def quantile(q):
        position=(len(ordered)-1)*q
        lo=math.floor(position);hi=math.ceil(position)
        return ordered[lo]+(ordered[hi]-ordered[lo])*(position-lo)
    return {'count':len(ordered),'mean':statistics.fmean(ordered),'min':ordered[0],
            'p50':quantile(.5),'p95':quantile(.95),'p99':quantile(.99),'max':ordered[-1]}

def analyze(root):
    root=Path(root).resolve();base=root/'data/reports/r01'
    computed={'profiles':{},'stage_table':[]};common_stages=None
    for profile in ('A','B'):
        files={kind:base/name for kind,name in (
            ('raw',profile+'.json.gz'),('report',profile+'_performance.json'),
            ('frame_batches',profile+'_frames.jsonl.gz'),
            ('camera_plan',profile+'_benchmark_camera.json.gz'))}
        bound={kind:{'path':path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,
                     'sha256':sha256(path)} for kind,path in files.items()}
        report=json.loads(files['report'].read_text())
        with gzip.open(files['raw'],'rt') as stream:raw=json.load(stream)
        with gzip.open(files['camera_plan'],'rt') as stream:plan=json.load(stream)
        assert bound['raw']['sha256']==report['raw_sha256']
        assert bound['frame_batches']['sha256']==report['frame_batches_sha256']
        bound['frame_batches']['decompressed_sha256']=sha256(files['frame_batches'],gzip_payload=True)
        assert bound['frame_batches']['decompressed_sha256']==raw['frame_storage']['batch_file_sha256']
        assert bound['camera_plan']['sha256']==report['camera_plan_archive_sha256']
        assert report['measurement_valid'] and report['full_protocol_complete'] and report['passed']
        stages=plan['source_stage_ticks']
        if common_stages is None:common_stages=stages
        else:assert common_stages==stages
        columns={name:index for index,name in enumerate(raw['frame_columns'])}
        frames=raw['frames'];window_count=len(report['windows']);window_s=raw['window_s']
        stage_frames={name:[] for name in stages}
        stage_windows={name:[[] for _ in range(window_count)] for name in stages}
        window_frames=[[] for _ in range(window_count)];unknown=0;ambiguous=0
        for row in frames:
            matching=[name for name,(lo,hi) in stages.items() if lo<=row[columns['source_tick']]<=hi]
            unknown+=not matching;ambiguous+=len(matching)>1
            if len(matching)!=1:continue
            name=matching[0];ms=row[columns['monotonic_frame_ms']]
            window=min(int(row[columns['t_end_s']]//window_s),window_count-1)
            stage_frames[name].append(ms);stage_windows[name][window].append(ms)
            window_frames[window].append(ms)
        assert unknown==ambiguous==0
        assert sum(map(len,stage_frames.values()))==len(frames)==raw['frame_count']==report['summary']['frames']
        for values,recorded in zip(window_frames,report['windows']):
            assert len(values)==recorded['frames']
            assert abs(distribution(values)['p95']-recorded['frame_ms']['p95'])<1e-10
        first_receipt=next(row['since_process_spawn_s'] for row in report['startup_log_receipt_events']
                           if row['line'].startswith('R01_MEASURE_START'))
        rss=[]
        for row in report['rss_samples']:
            offset=row['since_process_spawn_s']-first_receipt
            if row.get('pid')==raw['pid'] and isinstance(row.get('rss_bytes'),(int,float)) and 0<=offset<=raw['duration_actual_s']:
                rss.append((offset,row['rss_bytes']))
        assert len(rss)==report['memory_measurement']['valid_sample_count']
        gaps=[b[0]-a[0] for a,b in zip(rss,rss[1:])];rss_windows=[]
        for index in range(window_count):
            samples=[(t,value) for t,value in rss if index*window_s<=t<(index+1)*window_s]
            rss_windows.append({'index':index+1,'nominal_interval_s':[index*window_s,(index+1)*window_s],
                'first_valid_offset_s':samples[0][0],'last_valid_offset_s':samples[-1][0],
                'rss_bytes':distribution([value for _,value in samples]),
                'rss_MiB':distribution([value/1048576 for _,value in samples])})
        stats=distribution([row[columns['monotonic_frame_ms']] for row in frames])
        assert abs(stats['p95']-report['summary']['frame_ms']['p95'])<1e-10
        source_checks={row['name']:row['passed'] for row in report['checks'] if row['name'] in (
            'source.unchanged','runtime.unchanged','proof.unchanged','camera.source_record_unchanged',
            'camera.source_check_unchanged','camera.acceptance_binding_unchanged')}
        assert len(source_checks)==6 and all(source_checks.values())
        gpu_time={'raw_gpu_time_ms':raw['gpu_time_ms'],'report_gpu_frame_time_ms':report['gpu_frame_time_ms']}
        assert all(value is None for value in gpu_time.values())
        computed['profiles'][profile]={'inputs':bound,'profile':report['profile'],'engine':raw['engine'],
            'duration_actual_s':raw['duration_actual_s'],'warmup_actual_s':raw['warmup_actual_s'],
            'frame_ms':stats,'frames_above_33_3ms':sum(row[columns['monotonic_frame_ms']]>33.3 for row in frames),
            'unassigned_frame_count':unknown,'ambiguous_frame_count':ambiguous,
            'windows':[{'index':i+1,'frame_ms':distribution(values)} for i,values in enumerate(window_frames)],
            'rss':{'unit':'bytes; MiB=bytes/1048576','valid_sample_count':len(rss),
                'first_valid_offset_s':rss[0][0],'last_valid_offset_s':rss[-1][0],
                'first_endpoint_gap_s':rss[0][0],'last_endpoint_gap_s':raw['duration_actual_s']-rss[-1][0],
                'maximum_inter_sample_gap_s':max(gaps),'temporal_span_fraction':(rss[-1][0]-rss[0][0])/raw['duration_actual_s'],
                'all_valid_rss_bytes':distribution([value for _,value in rss]),'windows':rss_windows,
                'start_30s_rss_bytes':distribution([value for t,value in rss if t<30]),
                'end_30s_rss_bytes':distribution([value for t,value in rss if t>=raw['duration_actual_s']-30])},
            'static_memory_first_last_bytes':[frames[0][columns['MEMORY_STATIC']],frames[-1][columns['MEMORY_STATIC']]],
            'gpu_time':gpu_time,'system_before':{key:value for key,value in report['system_before'].items() if key!='heavy_processes'},
            'system_after':{key:value for key,value in report['system_after'].items() if key!='heavy_processes'},
            'background_process_snapshot_top_cpu':{'before':report['system_before']['heavy_processes']['top_cpu'][:3],
                                                    'after':report['system_after']['heavy_processes']['top_cpu'][:3]},
            'recorded_preservation_checks':source_checks,
            'performance_target_adopted_in_report':report['target_proposal']['performance_target_adopted']}
        for name in stages:
            row=next((item for item in computed['stage_table'] if item['stage']==name),None)
            if row is None:
                row={'stage':name,'source_tick_inclusive':stages[name]};computed['stage_table'].append(row)
            row[profile]={'frame_ms':distribution(stage_frames[name]),
                          'window_p95_frame_ms':[distribution(values)['p95'] for values in stage_windows[name]]}
        assert all(sha256(path)==bound[kind]['sha256'] for kind,path in files.items())
        computed['profiles'][profile]['input_artifacts_unchanged_during_analysis']=True
    return computed

if __name__=='__main__':
    print(json.dumps(analyze(Path.cwd()),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False))
